title: Wiring-answer cases from cited sources, Italian and English
goal: Wiring answers are checked against the build and the manufacturer's documents
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals 1 to 3 of the shared-asset review, solution:F-016-T05); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

Cases in fpvbuddy-v1 give a build and manufacturer excerpts in the prompt and expect the answer with the cited source ids, and a decline when the sources do not say; Italian first ("come collego il motore 2 all'ESC?") and English; graded like research-v1 (gauntlet-protocol:F-025-T02; cited ids as a set, json-match once released)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 8 cases from invented builds; waits on gauntlet-protocol:F-025-T02. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
